meta.name: A Suitable Boy
meta.description: Modernity confronts tradition in 1950s post-Partition India as a young woman resists an arranged marriage in favour of pursuit of love and a politician's son becomes involved in a transgressive affair.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In newly independent India, passionate literature student Lata Mehra defies tradition and her meddling mother’s wish to choose her a husband.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: When news of Lata’s secret romance reaches her mother, Rupa takes action to keep the young lovers apart.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Rupa enlists a friend to find her headstrong daughter a husband. In exile, Maan starts to enjoy village life.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sparks fly as Lata is reunited with Kabir, while self-starter Haresh faces up to the biggest challenge of his career. Meanwhile, Maan returns to Saeeda Bai.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: As India’s first national democratic election approaches, Lata finds herself courted by three very different suitors.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Lata makes a surprising decision about her future, as pressure on Maan’s family mounts after his disgrace.
